title: Constant-codimension polynomial lci charts and signed Koszul normalization
statement: For a scheme morphism $f:X\to S$ [def-pc-scheme] and $d\in\mathbf N$, a constant-codimension polynomial lci chart is a polynomial chart $(U,i:P\leftarrow U,P\to\mathbf A^n_S)$ [def-trf-polynomial-duality-presentation-data], together with $c\in\mathbf N$, $n=c+d$, local Koszul-regular generators of the immersion ideal of length $c$ [def-weil-pbc-koszul-regular-sequence], and local freeness of rank $c$ of the actual conormal module [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module] [lem-trf-lci-cotangent-presentation]. Put $C=i^*I$, $V=i^*\Omega^1_{P/S}$, $D=(\bigwedge^c C)^\vee\otimes\bigwedge^nV$ and $\omega=\bigwedge^n\Omega^1_{P/S}$, using [def-pc-module-pullback] [def-sc-relative-differential-sheaf] [def-sc-sheaf-exterior-power] [def-pur-sheaf-hom]. The corresponding two-term determinant model is the recorded conormal differential transported to its actual terms [lem-trf-two-term-perfect-determinant]. Regard derived coinduction $H$ and the single complex $i_*D[-c]$ as objects over $i_*\mathcal O_U$ [def-pc-derived-category] [def-trf-polynomial-duality-presentation-data]. A comparison $\rho:H(\omega[0])\simeq i_*D[-c]$ is normalized on an affine chart if the following holds for every regular generating tuple $g$, every standard quotient-augmented Koszul resolution $\epsilon:K(g)\to i_*\mathcal O_U[0]$, and every section $s$ of $i_*D$: whenever the evaluation adjunct of $\rho^{-1}(s)$ is represented by the roof $i_*\mathcal O_U[-c]\leftarrow K(g)[-c]\xrightarrow{z}\omega[0]$, its pairing with $\bar g_1\wedge\cdots\wedge\bar g_c$ equals $(-1)^{c(c-1)/2}$ times the reduction of $z(e_1\wedge\cdots\wedge e_c)$. This uses the total dual differential and ordered-contraction normalization of [def-sc-koszul-dual-complex] [def-sc-koszul-conormal-comparison]. The formula is quantified over all coefficients of all wedges of local differential sections, and makes no choice of a frame. The Koszul sheafification is the actual associated-sheaf functor transported by the canonical affine Spec isomorphism; the augmentation in degree zero is the quotient map, not a unit multiple. All scalar restrictions, shifts, the direct-image algebra action and the evaluation pairing are their existing constructions.
